name: Local Filesystem Bridge
description: Lets an agent read, write, and search files in a sandboxed local directory.

name: Git Repo Connector
description: Exposes repository browsing, diffs, and commit history to an agent.

name: Shell Sandbox
description: Runs shell commands in an isolated sandbox and streams the output back.

name: Database Inspector
description: Lets an agent inspect schemas and run read-only queries against a database.

name: Browser Automation Server
description: Drives a headless browser for navigation, form-filling, and screenshots.

name: Package Registry Lookup
description: Looks up package versions, dependencies, and changelogs across registries.

name: Log Tail Connector
description: Streams and searches recent application logs from a running service.

name: API Schema Explorer
description: Loads an OpenAPI spec so an agent can look up endpoints and parameters.

name: Task Board Connector
description: Reads and updates cards on a kanban-style task board.

name: Note Vault Bridge
description: Gives an agent read/write access to a local notes vault.

name: Document Drafting Server
description: Creates and edits structured documents from an agent's output.

name: Spreadsheet Connector
description: Reads and writes cells in a local spreadsheet file.

name: Reminder Scheduler
description: Lets an agent create and manage local time-based reminders.

name: Clipboard History Server
description: Exposes recent clipboard history for an agent to reference.

name: PDF Form Filler Server
description: Fills structured fields into a local PDF form template.

name: CSV Warehouse Connector
description: Queries a folder of CSV files as if they were tables.

name: Analytics Events Connector
description: Lets an agent query recent product analytics events.

name: Chart Rendering Server
description: Renders a chart image from structured data an agent provides.

name: Vector Index Server
description: Exposes semantic search over a local embedding index.

name: Spreadsheet Formula Runner
description: Evaluates spreadsheet-style formulas over structured input data.

name: Geo Lookup Server
description: Resolves place names to coordinates and basic regional metadata.

name: Data Quality Checker
description: Runs configurable data-quality checks against a tabular dataset.

name: Email Inbox Connector
description: Lets an agent read and draft emails in a connected inbox.

name: Team Chat Connector
description: Reads recent channel messages and posts updates to team chat.

name: Calendar Sync Server
description: Reads upcoming events and proposes new calendar invites.

name: Video Call Notes Server
description: Pulls transcripts and notes from a recorded video call.

name: SMS Notification Bridge
description: Sends short text notifications through a connected messaging provider.

name: Contact Directory Lookup
description: Looks up contact details from a connected address book.

name: Translation Relay Server
description: Relays text through a translation backend and returns the result.

name: Workflow Trigger Server
description: Lets an agent trigger predefined automation workflows.

name: Webhook Relay
description: Forwards structured events from an agent to an external webhook.

name: Cron Job Manager
description: Lets an agent create and inspect scheduled recurring jobs.

name: Form Submission Watcher
description: Watches for new form submissions and hands them to an agent.

name: File Sync Connector
description: Syncs files between a local directory and a connected cloud drive.

name: Approval Flow Server
description: Routes an agent's proposed action through a human approval step.

name: Batch Job Runner
description: Queues and runs longer batch jobs on behalf of an agent.

name: Notification Digest Server
description: Batches scattered notifications into a single periodic digest.
